stem: 以下关于美国海外资产控制办公室(OFAC)制裁的陈述,哪两项是正确的？(选择两项.)

options.A: 制裁只能针对由美国海外资产控制办公室(OFAC)指定的外国特定个人实施.
options.B: 被冻结的资金必须存入金融机构账上的有息账户.
options.C: 制裁可以是全面性的,也可以是有选择性的,通过冻结资产和贸易限制来实现外交政策和国家安全目标.
options.D: 美国海外资产控制办公室(OFAC)的制裁措施在五年后会自动失效,除非国会予以延长.

stem_en: Which two of the following statements are true regarding Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctions? (Select two.)

options_en.A: Sanctions can only be placed on certain individuals in foreign countries as designated by OFAC.
options_en.B: Blocked funds must be placed into an interest-bearing account on a financial institution's books.
options_en.C: Sanctions can be either comprehensive or selective, using the blocking of assets and trade restrictions to accomplish foreign policy and national security goals.
options_en.D: OFAC sanctions automatically expire after five years unless renewed by Congress.
